title: SeedDispatchRequest
description: Schema for GitHub Actions workflow dispatch inputs and local CLI arguments for demo content seeding

repository.description: Target repository name. Auto-created if missing.

scopeLevel.description: Scope level governing the seeded assets

contentType.description: Preset name or comma-separated list of migration module IDs

patSecretName.description: Name of secret containing the GitHub Personal Access Token

dryRun.description: When true, simulates operations without mutating remote state

cleanupExisting.description: When true, purges existing demo assets matching prefix before re-seeding

resourcePrefix.description: Prefix used for created demo assets
